_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Infested Plants#000.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#001.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#001.dst: 哦，{u}！你在這。見到你真好。準備好繼續往 {p} 走了嗎？
Infested Plants#001.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#002.src: It seems we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... But between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#002.dst: 看來我們得先穿過 {p}。我聽說那座森林裡到處都是蜘蛛……不過你我之間說說，我們應該——
Infested Plants#002.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#003.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#003.dst: 喂——喂！你們兩個！你們是士兵吧？從你們那身怪品味我看得出來。你們這種人不是應該幫助別人嗎？所以——幫幫忙！

Infested Plants#004.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#004.dst: 啊？哦——當然！你叫什麼名字？需要什麼幫忙？
Infested Plants#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#005.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#005.dst: 我叫 Ope！我最近……呃……被蜘蛛咬了！現在我需要你們幫我拿一種稀有的藥草來治我！
Infested Plants#005.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#006.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#006.dst: 那東西只長在一個滿是爬蟲的洞窟裡。而我這副身體顯然沒辦法自己去拿！
Infested Plants#006.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#007.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#007.dst: 好吧，沒問題！我們本來就是來幫忙的，所以……那株藥草我們替你拿！
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: Perfect. I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me, soldiers!
Infested Plants#008.dst: 太好了。我帶你們到洞窟，剩下的就交給你們。跟我來，士兵們！
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, here we are! The cave's right over there - just climb up the rocks and jump into it.
Infested Plants#010.dst: 好啦，到了！洞窟就在那邊——爬上那些岩石跳進去就行。
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#011.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#011.dst: 嗯……你們有兩個人。太好了！一個爬上去進洞窟，另一個留在下面保護我不被那些爬來爬去的蜘蛛咬！
Infested Plants#011.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#012.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#012.dst: 好！{u}，你進洞窟，我在這裡護著 Ope。
Infested Plants#012.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#013.src: Good, good. Well, good luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#013.dst: 很好、很好。那麼，上面小心啊！盡量別被蜘蛛咬太多口！
Infested Plants#013.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#014.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#014.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] Ope 身後的蜘蛛洞窟裡找出藥草。

Infested Plants#015.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.

Infested Plants#016.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#016.dst: 你可算回來了！感覺我們等了好幾個鐘頭。
Infested Plants#016.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#017.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#017.dst: 其實……根本沒那麼久。頂多十分鐘吧。
Infested Plants#017.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#018.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#018.dst: 呃……總之！藥草拿到了嗎？那東西非常——呃，重要！可以治好我。對。
Infested Plants#018.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#019.src: There it is! Eheh. Thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment...Let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#019.dst: 就是它！嘿嘿。多謝兩位辛苦了，士兵！那麼，關於你們的報酬……我看看，我身上有什麼……
Infested Plants#019.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#020.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- I can, uh, offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time.
Infested Plants#020.dst: 哦。我的綠寶石好像用完了。不過——我可以，呃，給你們一點建議！這座森林裡有很多東西可以找。有不少藏著寶物的洞窟值得探！說不定挺划算的。
Infested Plants#020.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#021.src: Wait, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#021.dst: 等等，你該不會真的不打算——
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#022.src: It has been a time, soldiers, but I truly must be going! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road! Go and speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#022.dst: 時間不早了，士兵們，我真的得走了！我們離 {p} 很近，你們該過去看看！沿著大路一直往東走就到了！去找鎮長談！他可以幫我付這筆帳！
Infested Plants#022.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#025.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#025.dst: 這實在……讓人火大。他從一開始就一副不老實的樣子，我早該——……算了。木已成舟。我們去找那位鎮長吧。
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#026.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#027.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#027.dst: 啊，旅人……歡迎來到我們這座樸實的林間小鎮。兩位是要留下來，還是只是路過？
Infested Plants#027.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#028.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#028.dst: 大概是後者。不過，我們遇到一個叫 Ope 的人，他要我們來找您談。
Infested Plants#028.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#029.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with.
Infested Plants#029.dst: 哦，Ope 啊……看來兩位跟他打交道的過程不太愉快？我得替他向兩位致歉，他是個……不太好相處的人。
Infested Plants#029.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#030.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#030.dst: 來，我給兩位一小筆綠寶石當作賠罪。希望他沒有壞了兩位對我們這座小鎮的印象……
Infested Plants#030.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#031.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#031.dst: 哦……謝謝您。您真是太客氣了。我們大概會待上一陣子，再繼續往 {p} 去。
Infested Plants#031.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#032.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay is.
Infested Plants#032.dst: 那就請兩位把這裡當自己家！不論停留多久，我們都歡迎每一位旅人。
Infested Plants#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#033.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...
Infested Plants#033.dst: 哦，{u}！你在這。見到你真好。照理說我們該繼續往 {p} 走，可是……

Infested Plants#034.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#034.dst: 看來得先穿過 {p}。聽說那座森林裡到處都是蜘蛛……不死族也一樣危險，老樣子……不過我們兩個應該還是——

Infested Plants#035.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?
Infested Plants#035.dst: 喂、喂！你們兩個！你們是軍人吧？

Infested Plants#037.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!
Infested Plants#037.dst: 對嘛，看你們那身怪品味就知道！你們這種人不是該幫人嗎？那就。幫忙啊！

Infested Plants#038.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...
Infested Plants#038.dst: 呃，是啦——不過你是誰？怎麼一個人跑到外面來，這樣不危險嗎？不死族不是……

Infested Plants#039.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.
Infested Plants#039.dst: 我叫 Ope！至於不死族……欸，這一帶沒那麼多。倒是蜘蛛不挑對象，逮到誰算誰。

Infested Plants#040.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?
Infested Plants#040.dst: 這樣……好吧，說得也是。你需要我們幫什麼忙？

Infested Plants#041.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.
Infested Plants#041.dst: 我……呃……是這樣，這片林子裡長著一種稀有的藥草，對吧？那東西很重要。可是我只知道一個地方找得到，就是那個爬滿噁心蜘蛛的巢穴。

Infested Plants#042.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.
Infested Plants#042.dst: 而且你也知道，我、我又不是軍人！總不能自己衝進去拿吧！所以我才想說，你們能不能幫我這個忙。

Infested Plants#043.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!
Infested Plants#043.dst: 嗯……我們來 Wynn 本來就是為了幫忙。所以……那株藥草我們幫你拿！

Infested Plants#044.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!
Infested Plants#044.dst: 太好了。太好了！我帶你們到洞口，剩下的就交給你們。跟我來！

Infested Plants#045.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.
Infested Plants#045.dst: 好，到了！洞口就在那邊——爬上那些岩石再跳下去就行。很安全的！呃，大概吧。

Infested Plants#046.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?
Infested Plants#046.dst: ……唔哇。連這上面都一堆蜘蛛……欸，反正你們有兩個人——一個進去拿藥草，另一個就，呃……幫我擋一下那些爬來爬去的蜘蛛？

Infested Plants#047.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.
Infested Plants#047.dst: 我沒問題。{u}，你進洞裡去，我在上面顧著 Ope。

Infested Plants#048.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#048.dst: 對……很好！好、好！那個，呃，祝你好運！盡量別被蜘蛛咬太多口！

Infested Plants#049.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!
Infested Plants#049.dst: ……啊——你出來了！！怎麼那麼久，感覺我們等了好幾個小時！

Infested Plants#050.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.
Infested Plants#050.dst: 那個——……嗯。總、總之！藥草拿到了嗎？那東西很重要的，對。

Infested Plants#051.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.
Infested Plants#051.dst: 說起來……你好像一直沒說你要那東西做什麼。

Infested Plants#052.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.
Infested Plants#052.dst: 哦，我——欸嘿，那……我……呃，其實這、這不關你的事。

Infested Plants#053.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#053.dst: 我、我很感謝兩位軍人幫忙！那麼，報酬的部分……我看看，身上還有什麼……

Infested Plants#054.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!
Infested Plants#054.dst: 哦。我的綠寶石好像用完了。那、那我、我可以給你們一點建議！這片森林裡好東西多得是。還有一堆藏著寶物的洞穴可以探！說不定值得你們跑一趟！

Infested Plants#055.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#055.dst: 等等，什麼？喂，你該不會真的不打算——

Infested Plants#056.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!
Infested Plants#056.dst: 兩位軍人，跟你們相處得很愉快，但我、我真的得走了！還有要緊事要辦！這裡離 {p} 不遠，你們可以順道去看看！沿著大路一直往東就到了！

Infested Plants#057.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#057.dst: 你們可以，呃，去找鎮長談！我的帳讓他來付！

Infested Plants#059.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.
Infested Plants#059.dst: 真是……讓人不痛快。我只是想知道而已……算了，事情都這樣了。我們就去找他說的那位鎮長吧。

Infested Plants#060.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.
Infested Plants#060.dst: 我先走一步。我們在 {p} 碰面，沿著大路往東走就到了。

Infested Plants#061.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#061.dst: 啊，兩位新兵……歡迎來到我們這座小小的森林城鎮。是要住下來，還是只是路過呢？

Infested Plants#062.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#062.dst: 只是路過，我們要去 {p}。不過……我們遇到一個叫 Ope 的人，他要我們來找您談談。

Infested Plants#063.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.
Infested Plants#063.dst: 哦，Ope 啊……我猜你們跟他談得不太愉快吧？我替他向兩位道歉，他這個人……有時候確實不好相處。

Infested Plants#064.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#064.dst: 哦……謝謝您。您太客氣了。我們大概會待上一陣子，再繼續往 {p} 走。

Infested Plants#065.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
Infested Plants#065.dst: 那就請兩位別客氣，把這裡當自己家！不管待多久，我們都歡迎所有旅人。
